DRIP & DUSK / CUSTOMER CARE

Refund & cancellation policy

When you can cancel or return an order, and how refunds work.

Last updated 29 October 2026

Cancelling an order

  • Before dispatch: contact us with your order reference and we will cancel the order and refund you in full.
  • After dispatch: the order can no longer be cancelled. If you refuse the delivery, the refund is made after the parcel returns to us, less the original delivery charge.
  • Unpaid orders are released automatically after the payment window; nothing is charged.

Returns

Because fragrances are personal-care products, we cannot accept returns for change of mind or for how a fragrance smells on you.

  • Decants are filled to order and cannot be returned.
  • Damaged, leaking or wrong items: tell us within 48 hours of delivery with your order reference and clear photos or an unboxing video showing the problem. Once we confirm the issue, we will send a replacement or refund you in full, including delivery.
  • Please do not send items back before we have confirmed the return; we will tell you how.

Refunds

  • Razorpay payments are refunded to the original payment method. Banks usually take 5–7 working days to show the refund.
  • Direct UPI payments are refunded to the UPI ID or bank account the payment came from.
  • We start an approved refund within 2 working days, and we will share the refund reference with you.

Contact

To cancel an order or report a problem, contact us with your order reference (it begins with DD-).
